findings.detail: Rows under the source section Cash and Cash Equivalents were extracted with blank exposure_type even though the source supplies the cash-equivalent classification.

rationale: C303 flags blank exposure_type, a controlled classification field. The raw SOI table localizes the affected block to a Cash and Cash Equivalents section: table 99 row 23 is the section label, rows 24-29 are named cash/money-market instruments, and row 30 totals the same section. The stored observed value is blank, while the source disposition provides the classification, so the flag is a real data error rather than a false alarm.
